g.text: Free day
Local clock hour
Participant-hours
Bars show the supported fitted rows at each integer hour
C Available participant-hours by local time
Exploratory nonlinear two-part generalized additive model (GAM) display.
Curves give sedentary and active status equal weight and standardize equally across the nine
study sites.
Displayed curves omit participant and participant-day random effects. Bands and ratio
intervals are approximate pointwise 95% intervals with fixed smoothing parameters; uncertainty
does not include covariance between the occurrence and positive-magnitude components.
Filled and hollow points distinguish intervals that exclude and include 1. These intervals
apply to individual displayed hours, not a simultaneous or multiplicity-controlled whole-curve
test.
The panel-A transformation is display-only.
